diagnosticGoal: distinguish installed-app setup issues, file-picker issues, local renderer compatibility issues, CAD interpretation feedback and commercial-readiness questions without activating production upload or conversion paths
minimumCapture: tester role or opaque reviewer reference
WebView or Chrome version if visible
app install source or APK artifact reference
visible app version or build reference if available
whether Open internal CAD preview is visible
whether Live upload locked appears instead of the internal preview path
whether selected file appeared in the app
whether dimensions, grid, zoom and orientation controls appeared
whether zoom state persisted across orientation changes
screenshot or short clip when possible

classification.defaultAction: confirm direct APK artifact, relaunch/update state and embedded renderer URL before changing source
capture device picker details and reproduce with public or synthetic files before changing backend gates

signals: render action missing after file selection
classification.defaultAction: treat as local renderer or file-compatibility issue; do not infer upload, conversion or Sandbox failure
route to source or fixture interpretation review and keep external-validation claims blocked
answer from remaining gates and cost workbook; do not imply commercialization readiness

supportCostHooks.feePerRunImpact: support effort must be measured before quoting a customer fee

implementationSurface.rule: keep diagnostics collapsed and support-focused so the primary tester action remains Open internal CAD preview

responseBoundaries: do not ask Mark for private CAD in this review path
do not request production credentials or account enrollment
do not send a new external message from this source packet
do not claim a backend upload, conversion or Sandbox failure from a local preview symptom
do not store recipient addresses, private file paths or raw CAD contents in source
use opaque local evidence references for screenshots, clips or email receipts
nextSafeAction: human QA of the compact internal-preview diagnostics surface before merging the UI change
